authority_rule: Written canon controls facts and spatial relationships. Visual authority controls rendering and presentation only.

world_visual_authority.title: World Visual Design Philosophy — Architecture, Fashion & Technology — V2
world_visual_authority.rule: Modernity before magic. Use culturally specific late-19th/early-20th-century-adjacent fantasy design, Hemlock ecological sophistication, correct human-faced Harengon anatomy, and precision craft with selective magical information technology.

location_media_roles.wayfolio_record: Clean discovered-place artwork used as media inside the World record; never a fake phone screen or flattened Wayfolio interface.
location_media_roles.shared_ipad_exterior_approach: Mandatory separate 4:3 full-bleed exterior, approach, or exterior-equivalent gameplay scene for every built location; a Wayfolio portrait never substitutes for it.
location_media_roles.shared_ipad_gameplay_zone: A 4:3 full-bleed interior, activity, or functional-zone scene that adds distinct playable information.
location_media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_counter: A 4:3 first-person customer view from the player side of a shop or service counter.
location_media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_seated: A 4:3 first-person seated-at-table view for a restaurant, cafe, tea house, or similar venue.
location_media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_table_service: A 4:3 first-person seated view with a server taking the order when table service is supported.
location_media_roles.weather_time_state: A separately registered weather or lighting state that does not overwrite the location's existing approved presentation.
location_media_roles.reuse: An explicitly approved image may serve both roles when it provides the same useful information; do not manufacture redundant variants.
location_media_roles.approval: Generated outputs remain in review until explicitly approved by the user. Explicit approval is recorded by stable subject ID plus semantic role; folder presence and newest timestamps are not authority.

asset_lifecycle.approved_current: Explicitly approved active asset for one stable subject, semantic role, and context.
asset_lifecycle.approved_reference: Explicitly approved reference that may be used when no safe approved-current asset exists.
asset_lifecycle.superseded: Retained historical asset replaced atomically by a newer approved-current asset.
asset_lifecycle.rejected_do_not_use: Retained for audit but unavailable to player-facing retrieval.

runtime_registry.rule: The Host downloads, validates, and caches approved-current rows at runtime. This local manifest and native bundle are bootstrap/fallback only.
